name: unlocker-markdown-ok
description: Web Unlocker happy path, a real 2026-09-23 recording of `format: "raw"` with `data_format: "markdown"` — the payload is the converted page as a bare STRING, not an object. Pins the engine's sniffing decode: a body that is not JSON rides through as a faithful Json string, so no connector-side parsing is needed and none is authored.
